name: Continuidad de Contorno
description: Analiza la continuidad de contornos faciales en video para detectar deepfakes
algorithm: Contour Continuity — Análisis Espacial a Nivel de Píxel
mechanism:
This method analyzes facial contour continuity for deepfake detection following Li et al. (2020) Face X-ray:

1. **Facial Contorno Extracción**: The complete facial contour — forehead hairline, temple, cheekbone, jawline, chin — is traced per frame using high-resolution edge detection and facial landmark interpolation. The contour is parameterized as a smooth curve with measured curvature at each point.

2. **Curvature Continuity Análisis**: Natural facial contours are C² continuous (smooth second derivative) except at anatomical feature boundaries (chin point, jaw angle). The method detects breaks in curvature continuity — deepfake face swaps may produce contour kinks or unnaturally straight segments where the generated face mesh interfaces with the original face boundary.

3. **Contorno - Piel Límite Análisis**: Following Li et al.'s Face X-ray approach, the method examines the blending boundary between the face and surrounding area. Authentic faces have seamless continuation from face to neck/hair. Deepfakes create a detectable blending boundary where the generated face patch meets the original footage, visible as subtle texture or color discontinuities along the contour.

4. **Temporal Contorno Seguimiento**: The facial contour is tracked across frames. Natural contours deform smoothly according to facial muscles and head rotation. Deepfake contours may exhibit temporal jitter — small frame-to-frame fluctuations in contour position inconsistent with smooth physical motion, caused by independent per-frame face generation.

5. **Multi - Scale Contorno Puntuación**: Contour continuity is analyzed at multiple scales: coarse (overall shape), medium (local curvature), and fine (pixel-level edge quality). Natural faces show consistent quality at all scales. Deepfakes may show good coarse continuity but poor fine-scale continuity at blending boundaries, yielding a graded forensic score.
parameters:
Tipo de análisis: píxel
Medio: video
Entrada: Video frames extracted at key intervals
Salida: Puntuación de confianza (0-100)
Frame sampling: Adaptive (1-5 fps depending on method)
Temporal window: Sliding window across frame sequence
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-88% precisión independiente. Most effective when combined with other video forensic methods. Performance depends on video quality, resolution, and compression level.
source: Video forensics and deepfake detection research. Based on computer vision and temporal signal analysis methods.
useCase: Detección de deepfake y video generado por IA mediante contour continuity analysis. Este método examina características temporales y espaciales que son difíciles de replicar perfectamente por sistemas de IA, proporcionando evidencia para la evaluación de autenticidad del video.
strengths:
• Captura artefactos temporales que el análisis de cuadro único pierde
• Funciona con formatos de video estándar
• Efectivo contra técnicas comunes de deepfake
• Se puede combinar con otros métodos forenses de video
• Basado en investigación establecida de visión por computadora
limitations:
• Rendimiento afectado por la compresión y resolución del video
• Algunos métodos requieren suficiente cantidad de cuadros para el análisis temporal
• La efectividad varía según la técnica de generación de deepfake
• Se usa mejor como parte de un pipeline integral de múltiples métodos
• Puede producir falsos positivos en videos auténticos con edición intensiva

references.title: Li, Y. et al. (2020). Face X-ray for More General Face Forgery Detection. CVPR.
Rossler, A. et al. (2019). FaceForensics++: Learning to Detect Manipulated Facial Images. ICCV.
